name: xapi
label: xAPI (Experience API)
description: Learning analytics standard — Actor/Verb/Object statement model used by US DoD and corporate training

table_notes.xapi_actor: Represents a learner or system (Agent or Group) identified by mbox, openid, or account; one of the four identifier fields must be populated per xAPI spec.
table_notes.xapi_verb: Controlled vocabulary of actions a learner performs; the PK is the full IRI (e.g. http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/completed) per xAPI spec.
table_notes.xapi_activity: A learning object, course, assessment, or any IRI-identified resource that can be the target of a statement.
table_notes.xapi_statement: Central fact table recording each learning event as Actor–Verb–Object with optional result and context; immutable once stored per xAPI spec.

xapi_actor.name: id
xapi_actor.description: Surrogate primary key; xAPI actors have no mandatory single identifier

xapi_actor.name: account_name
xapi_actor.description: Username or account ID on the platform identified by account_homepage

xapi_actor.name: account_homepage
xapi_actor.description: IRI of the system where account_name is registered (xAPI account identifier)

xapi_actor.name: mbox
xapi_actor.description: Mailto IRI uniquely identifying the actor (e.g. mailto:user@example.com); xAPI inverse functional identifier

xapi_actor.name: mbox_sha1sum
xapi_actor.description: SHA-1 hash of the mbox IRI for privacy-preserving actor identification

xapi_actor.name: openid
xapi_actor.description: OpenID IRI uniquely identifying the actor; alternative to mbox when privacy is required

xapi_actor.name: name
xapi_actor.description: Human-readable display name of the actor; not used for identity matching

xapi_actor.name: object_type
xapi_actor.description: xAPI actor type: 'Agent' (individual) or 'Group' (collection of agents)

xapi_verb.name: id
xapi_verb.description: Full IRI identifying the verb (e.g. http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/completed); globally unique per xAPI spec

xapi_verb.name: display
xapi_verb.description: Language map of human-readable verb labels keyed by RFC 5646 language tag (e.g. {"en-US": "completed"})

xapi_activity.name: id
xapi_activity.description: IRI uniquely identifying the activity (e.g. course URL or URN); globally unique per xAPI spec

xapi_activity.name: name
xapi_activity.description: Language map of human-readable activity names keyed by RFC 5646 language tag

xapi_activity.name: description
xapi_activity.description: Language map of human-readable activity descriptions keyed by RFC 5646 language tag

xapi_activity.name: more_info
xapi_activity.description: IRI linking to additional human-readable information about the activity

xapi_activity.name: extensions
xapi_activity.description: Arbitrary IRI-keyed extension data for activity-specific metadata not covered by the spec

xapi_statement.name: id
xapi_statement.description: xAPI statement UUID; may be assigned by the LRS or provided by the client at submission

xapi_statement.name: actor_id
xapi_statement.description: References xapi_actor; identifies who performed the learning action

xapi_statement.name: verb_id
xapi_statement.description: References xapi_verb by IRI; the action performed (e.g. completed, attempted, passed)

xapi_statement.name: object_type
xapi_statement.description: Type of the statement object: 'Activity', 'Agent', 'Group', 'SubStatement', or 'StatementRef'

xapi_statement.name: object_activity_id
xapi_statement.description: References xapi_activity when object_type is 'Activity'; the learning object acted upon

xapi_statement.name: result_score_raw
xapi_statement.description: Raw score achieved by the actor on this activity (units defined by the activity)

xapi_statement.name: result_score_max
xapi_statement.description: Maximum possible raw score for this activity; used to normalise result_score_raw

xapi_statement.name: result_completion
xapi_statement.description: True if the actor completed the activity per the activity's completion criteria

xapi_statement.name: result_success
xapi_statement.description: True if the actor passed or succeeded at the activity per its success criteria

xapi_statement.name: result_duration_seconds
xapi_statement.description: Time the actor spent on the activity in seconds (converted from xAPI ISO 8601 duration)

xapi_statement.name: context
xapi_statement.description: xAPI context object: registration UUID, instructor, team, contextActivities, extensions, and language

xapi_statement.name: timestamp
xapi_statement.description: When the learning event occurred (client-supplied); may differ from stored_at

xapi_statement.name: stored_at
xapi_statement.description: When the LRS received and stored this statement; set server-side on insert

xapi_statement.name: authority
xapi_statement.description: Agent or OAuth consumer that submitted this statement; used for trust and provenance tracking

short_description: Learning analytics standard — Actor/Verb/Object statement model used by US DoD and corporate training
long_description: xAPI (Experience API / Tin Can) defines a simple but extensible statement structure — Actor Verb Object — for recording any learning experience. The schema captures the actor (learner), verb (completed, attempted, passed), activity (course, assessment, video), and result (score, duration, completion status) with full context.
when_to_use: Use for corporate LMS, training management systems, learning analytics platforms, or any edtech tool that needs to track learning experiences. Adopted by US DoD SCORM successors and required by ADL (Advanced Distributed Learning). Used by Coursera, LinkedIn Learning, and major corporate LMS vendors for xAPI data export.
